action: Wrote the residue: re-implemented Theorem 6.3 of Leung-Schmidt 2016 with the parameter search of its Remark 6.2, ran it on all 237,807 values of L with an independent checker (enumeration-run-1), and reconstructed the unpublished survivor set R of 8,125 values; the 229,682 eliminated values carry verified certificates.
output: The finite residue: the claim holds for all of L if and only if it holds for every u in R (8,125 explicit values, sorted, smallest 30109*1128713*2167849*268813277), since every other u in L has a verified Theorem 6.3 certificate. R matches the published count and smallest element. Structure of R: every element contains the four primes 30109, 1128713, 2167849, 268813277; 35 distinct primes occur; Omega(u) ranges from 4 to 16.
